title: Build → Learn → Teach
tagline: The flywheel that multiplies your impact
summary: Most people learn by reading. I learn by building — and then I teach what I built. This flywheel means every project compounds: you don't just ship something, you extract the lessons and then multiply your impact by sharing them with others.

pillars.name: Build
pillars.description: Ship real things. Build AI systems that work in production, not just demos. The constraint of real stakes forces clarity. [NEEDS REVIEW BY MARLON]

pillars.name: Learn
pillars.description: Extract the lessons. What broke? What surprised you? What would you tell someone starting this journey today? The debrief is where the real knowledge lives.

pillars.name: Teach
pillars.description: Multiply impact. Share what you built and learned in a way that creates Aha! moments for others. When you teach, you also deepen your own understanding.

pillars.name: Inspire
pillars.description: Make the world bigger for the people you teach. The goal isn't just to transfer knowledge — it's to show people what's possible so they go build their own thing.

keyQuestions: What would I have wanted to know when I started this?
What surprised me most about this build?
Who needs to know this, and what's the simplest way to explain it?
How does this connect to something my audience already understands?
exampleInPractice: When I built VoicePath AI, I documented every architecture decision, every integration challenge, and every lesson learned. That documentation became the curriculum for a series of workshops that helped hundreds of professionals understand voice AI — and several of them went on to build their own voice agents. The build multiplied. [NEEDS REVIEW BY MARLON]
